newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firmer on Grand Met, Guinness froth.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firmer on Grand Met, Guinness froth.

text.p: UK shares were slightly higher on Monday, as a proposed merger between Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc added sparkle to the drinks and leisure sectors.
But after rising nine straight sessions and 17 of the past 18 trading days, the FTSE's scope for further headway is seen limited, dealers said.
"The merger has really kept the market afloat this morning but I don't think it will be enough to stop people taking some profits later today," the head of trading at a major investment bank said.
